Hymn 124: Be Still, My Soul
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: A Major
Composer: Jean Sibelius
Lyricist/Text Author: Katharina von Schlegel
Category: Prayer and Supplication

This is hymn number 124 titled "Be Still, My Soul" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in A Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Jean Sibelius and the lyrics were written by Katharina von Schlegel.
This hymn is categorized under: Prayer and Supplication.
